title: Flat descent of catenarity and equidimensionality
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a flat local map of Noetherian local rings. Assume that $B$ is catenary and $\operatorname{Spec}(B)$ is equidimensional. Then for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$, $\operatorname{Spec}(B/\mathfrak pB)$ is equidimensional, and $A$ is catenary and $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ is equidimensional.
